assessment.coherence: The window is one design. M18.108 gives core a single pure encodeShapePack. The SDK's buildShapePackFiles, format's importedShapePack and iconifyShapePack all call it, and format's canonicalJson re-exports core's, so the duplicate encoder cp11 F4 found is gone. M18.110 builds the version ledger and the explicit write run on that encoder. M18.26 and M18.27 use the shared suite and encoder. M18.39 keeps the engine ABI pure in format and instantiates WASM in the editor. Cross-commit drift remains: the BPMN pack name differs from the requirement (F3), and the per-pack test file is copied eight times (F7).
assessment.specFidelity: M18.107, M18.108, M18.110, M18.27 and M18.39 meet their EARS as written. M18.39's Fira Sans latin slice subsets to 33028 bytes against the 60000 budget, and its gate leg passes. M18.117 meets its pack-goldens and draw.io clauses. Windows was handled by ADR-0197, an option cp12 allowed. Its imported-pack clause was met by shrinking the input, not by fixing the cause (F4). M18.117 itself is correctly left todo pending a green run. M18.26 ships 19 BPMN-lite definitions, but under the name `bpmn`, so its completion leg is red (F3). No requirement was silently dropped. FR-LIB-008 stays partial pending M18.120 and M18.35.
assessment.standardsDrift: Non-negotiable 1 is still not honoured in practice. cp12's serialization rule for M18.117 was written in prose and was not followed: three feature commits landed while the row was todo, and three more landed onto a main whose macOS and Windows verify jobs were red (F1). Nightly has been red for days with no row (F2). One convention did hold: every landed task commit now carries an own-tree pass line bound to its content id. I recomputed contentId for 8879c64, bfce2d0, 943141e, 14d7ea0, 11fd580, 6e6d599 and cf3b049, and all match. check-digest --head --full-history reports 97 task commits covered. The Removes-test trailer on M18.110 cites where the check moved.
assessment.gateHonesty: The gate is at 46/75 and cannot pass early. Its CI-evidence, mutation and full-verification legs are correctly red. Spot mutants: (1) Removing M18.107's useEffect leaves aria-pressed true after deselect and reselect, so the new browser assertion fails; the test constrains. (2) In the pack-goldens sandbox, a deleted golden, an orphan golden, a leaked VITE_FLUXION_WRITE_PACK without -u, a changed ledger hash and a removed released entry each fail the run; the test constrains, and Windows and macOS now run it green. (3) An encoder that is quadratic in definition count passes, because imported-pack now packs 136 icons (F4). Structural problem: the mutation leg cannot go green while the plan needs 274 matrix jobs (F2). The 'bpmn-lite' leg is red on a done row (F3). checkpoint cadence is 7/8 at cf3b049, so this review is due.
assessment.architecture: No layering breach. core/shape/pack-encode.ts imports only schema and core's own sync SHA-256, and format/font-subset.ts imports only format-local helpers and an injected ContentHasher. Contract changes come with ADRs: ADR-0196 (one encoder, import provenance), the ADR-0194 amendment (unreleased 0.0.0 never recorded; released versions kept), and ADR-0197 (Windows 25 of 45 minutes). Public API grew: core +27 lines (encodeShapePack), format +88 and editor +51 (font subset), sdk testing +4 (UNRELEASED_PACK_VERSION). Two new public packs were added: @fluxion/pack-bpmn and @fluxion/pack-network. The new binary fixture fixtures/fonts/fira-sans-400.ttf (457 KB, OFL, with provenance) is test-only. No runtime dependency was added.
assessment.planHealth: There are 118 rows (90 done, 28 todo) against 43 planned, 2.74x. That is 5 rows up from cp12, all of them cp12 dispositions, and the 9 commits since cp12 closed 6 rows. Feature throughput recovered: 3 more packs; cloud-architecture, icons-lucide, devices and people remain. The bottleneck has moved from local bookkeeping to remote evidence. Ubuntu CI runners queue for hours, nightly is structurally red, and the streams keep landing despite prose stop rules. Later milestones should make every 'stop landing' disposition a mechanical land.mjs check, and should budget nightly and matrix capacity whenever the pure-package set grows.
